reviews.author: Christopher Moeller
reviews.text: Had my wheel hubs replaced on my 2012 Ram 2500. They had it done in a couple of hours. Now my truck is quiet again. Great service. Great prices. West Tire and Auto will be my go-to place for future repairs.

reviews.author: Grace I
reviews.text: Had my car towed after my clutch died on 17 Bus on Sunday night. West Tire fixed it on Monday to get me back on the road quickly!! I also use them regularly for oil changes. They're always get them done quickly. Great customer service, friendly, and trustworthy. I highly recommend using West Tire!

reviews.author: Chantal
reviews.text: This is the only place I will bring my car as a local, because I know that they're going to be honest. And as a female, I appreciate the staff here because they keep me updated and don't pressure me into getting unnecessary things fixed. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rod Stacy
reviews.text: The representatives of this service was absolutely awesome. When l say awesome it implores willingness to serve to meet people's car in a very practical and honest way.. it's good to finally see it in getting real repairs at good prices.

reviews.author: Drew Rice
reviews.text: Won’t hesitate to go back here if I need anything. They did a great job with my alignment and swapping some tires I bought with fair prices. They even hooked my little guy up with a freeze pop while we waited.

reviews.author: Stephan Trably
reviews.text: Very friendly staff, very professional. Hard to get a alignment done correctly with a lifted truck but they get it done everytime. Got my vehicle in exactly at the time of the appointment as well. I highly recommend this shop and will use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Charles Beaver
reviews.text: Brought my F150 in for AC repair and was very pleased with the service and the price. I was expecting a big repair bill but was pleasantly surprised, not to mention I had my truck back same day. My new go to for auto repairs. It’s always nice to find a place that treats their customers like family just like their sign says. Thank you to the whole crew at West Tire & Auto

reviews.author: Charles Bennett
reviews.text: Staff was friendly and understood my needs and gave good advice on how to get them resolved. The mechanic was great and had to correct things done at another shop. Suggested better parts and even gave me the part number. Will definitely be having work done there again.

reviews.author: Jeanne Prescott
reviews.text: I have frequented West Tires auto repair shop on 1624 Pine Island Rd, Myrtle Beach several times due to their earnest commitment to customer service, knowledge, professionalism, fair prices and honesty. A great group of guys!

reviews.author: susanreidy
reviews.text: I asked Gemini similar to the Google search the best front end alignment in Myrtle Beach and they came up with west tire I was very happy with the service the price and how my car feels right now!!! The guy at the front counter, Genuine kind, Funny and honest!!!?

reviews.author: Cortney Farrar
reviews.text: We were on vacation and emergently needed 2 back tires before driving home. Derek immediately found tires for us and the shop was super quick about replacing them so we could start our drive home. So thankful for the whole shop for helping us in a stressful situation!

reviews.author: Dominic Dambaugh
reviews.text: Been going here for 2 1/2 years and brought my Ford ranger in the shift linkage need adjusted. They got me taken care of. Ben walked me through what he fixed and did a great job!

reviews.author: Doug M
reviews.text: I brought by car in for a wheel alignment and left knowing I found the right place to bring my vehicles. The alignment for my car was unique because it is older, but they knew what to do and it now drives beautifully. The mechanic has an abundance of knowledge with these older cars! Price was excellent.

reviews.author: joann jones
reviews.text: I take all 3 of our automobiles to West Tires their customers services is out of this world polite, Courteous, kind, always thankful very few times have I had to wait for a long period of time. They never do any repairs without discussing it with you first. Prices are reasonable. I'd highly recommend everyone to go to West Tire. I give them a 5 star across the board they are amazing.

reviews.author: Application Center
reviews.text: Services was disappointing already missed a full day out of my vacation after being told a time frame… then got a excuse that made no sense which matches the date of my vacation. Communication was terrible…. Just find you someone that will give you clear and accurate answers. It was just terrible

reviews.author: Drew Swalls
reviews.text: West Tire and Auto Repair went above and beyond for me. They spent countless hours making sure my truck’s air ride suspension was completely dialed in and done the right way. You can tell they truly care about quality and not just rushing a job out the door. Their attention to detail, patience, and willingness to take the extra time made all the difference. If you want a shop that stands behind their work and actually takes pride in what they do, this is the place. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joel Cutlip
reviews.text: Great customer service. They fixed my car in a timely manner and they were reasonable on their prices. Would use them again

reviews.author: Joseph Hayes
reviews.text: Awesome workmanship and service! I can't say enough on the service!! Stephen was extremely helpful in helping me with the look I wanted! When it comes out even better than you thought or pictures, you know it's a job well done!! Thanks to the entire crew as well.!!

reviews.author: Lisa Grace
reviews.text: Appreciated upfront verbal estimate before officially diagnosing. Explained if’s & addt’l cost if needed. Fast service from ordering parts to completing job. Very nice people!

reviews.author: Sean Daveiga
reviews.text: Best in Horry county. They do great work. I was stuck in a bad situation with a high performance vehicle and West Tire's honesty, know-how, and urgency turned the situation completely around in a day. I trust no other shop & finally found a credible mechankc that's work is second to none. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Tom Ippolito
reviews.text: A friend of mine recommended me to West tire and Repair. I had a great experience the guys were very personable as well as the mechanics. I highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Gregg Conrad
reviews.text: I would highly recommend these people. They’re honest thorough and a very accommodating if you want a good quality shop in Myrtle Beach I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Robert Frank
reviews.text: I have a 32 year old car that developed a significant oil leak that I could not repair myself. No one in the region could do the work (rear main seal and seals on the oil pan which is a lot of work) but I was able to get it done at West Tire. Happy with the repair! Well done!

reviews.author: shea brown
reviews.text: Took my 2001 Mustang Bullitt for a tune up. Fantastic. Nice guys,,very honest,and tech was sharp and the price was extremely reasonable. I recommend these fellows with no reservations. You will never be ripped off here

reviews.author: James Izzolo
reviews.text: Took my 21 Ford Super Duty Tremor in because the front end was a little squirrelly…..Steven was awesome….they balanced the tires and checked the alignment! I couldn’t believe that they only charged me for the 4 wheel balances, even though they made some alignment adjustments!!!! This is the best and most honest place I ever brought any of my vehicles to!! Thank you West Tire!!! I’ll be back!

reviews.author: Rick Bernstein
reviews.text: Service was performed professionally on time in the staff. There is extremely knowledgeable. Definitely recommend them for things like tires and alignments And other work!

reviews.author: GraceCreation
reviews.text: I have gone to West for many years now for all my auto mechanic needs and I always get consistently great service at a fair price. Plus I like that they are locally owned and the owner recognizes Jesus as his Savior.

reviews.author: Kathy Roser
reviews.text: I came in for a tire problem I thought but after they took the time to look at everything we found the issue which wasn’t the tire after all. They are thorough knowledgeable and very nice. I highly recommend

reviews.author: Taji Mclellan
reviews.text: Amazing people and amazing experience! Absolutely recommend them. Very affordable and straight forward! I will be relying on them as my permanent mechanic and will refer everyone to them! Thank you ERIC mostly!!!

reviews.author: Christopher Kemp
reviews.text: These guys were great. They leveled out my truck, and did an alignment. Cost was very reasonable, and they stayed on the time frame they gave me. Punctual and Honest. You guys rock and have gained my business. Thanks.

reviews.author: Tim Bogart
reviews.text: Stopped in to see what a 4 wheel alignment would cost and when I could schedule it. They got me in right away and the price was reasonable. Good service.

reviews.author: Mark Smith
reviews.text: Derrick and the crew took care of my braking needs on my 1999 Lil Slk230. Derrick is very nice, genuine and trustworthy. He worked with me when my payment process was giving me a hard time. Very much appreciated. I will definitely return for more needs on my '99 buddy. Thank You Derrick and the crew.

reviews.author: Christopher Myers
reviews.text: Local recommended. Found and fixed the problem. Could have “found” something more expensive to do and I’d’ve been none the wiser. Instead it was $30 and out the door. Bonus: they gave me a prediction on when to come back for the brakes; I will be there.

reviews.author: Chad Davis
reviews.text: Hands down the best place to take your car for an alignment. Took my 71 nova to them after installing all new tubular a arms in the front and Tim dialed it in perfectly. Can't thank them enough.

reviews.author: Amy Wood
reviews.text: Very pleased with the service we received from them. I spoke with Ryan on the phone to get help with my stepson's car as well live 700+ miles away. He was extremely helpful and honest with everything that we needed to do to his car. Would recommend this place to anyone. They were easy to deal with got an appointment the next day and all work was preformed the same day. Thank you for taking care of his car for us.

reviews.author: Landon Moore
reviews.text: I brought in my 2002 avalanche that is lifted and has 37 inch tires for an alignment. This shop did great work! Very affordable and a very professional service. Will definitely be back! My truck hasn’t been as smooth driving like now since it was made in the factory.

reviews.author: noah miller
reviews.text: Got my alignment done yesterday these guys are great. The only place I would use in town especially if your car is lowered.

reviews.author: Beach Time
reviews.text: Warranty is A Plus, had a nail, fast fix at No Charge. I get many compliments on the New Tires. 2nd Time for 4 New KENDA KR52, my Jeep Cherokee. Love the tread and the cost total with warranty. Needed 2 to 4 new tires for my daughter’s 2019 Chev Trax. Called 5 discount tire dealerships. West Tire and Auto Repair was the winner based on customer phone service, tire rated mileage, cost, warranty and next day installation. One Stop Shop. Friendly Family Owned Services. Great Location near Grand Coastal Mall. Oil Change Time, walk in, done in a few hours, rotated tires purchased from them and low cost full synthetic oil.

reviews.author: Holly Gardner
reviews.text: the shops here are swamped in the summer months! but they still got me in and checked something for me. So helpful!

reviews.author: Michael Taylor
reviews.text: This place is awesome. Been here since they started and the quality and service has always been top tier. Never been disappointed. Highly recommend if you are looking for a shop , this is the place

reviews.author: Anna Konya
reviews.text: There is something to be said about a family ran business. West Tire and auto repair took the time to listen to me and they fixed the issue when other shops couldn’t! West Tire will be the go to for all my Vette and Challenger repairs.

reviews.author: Fuquan G
reviews.text: I couldn’t start my car after shopping at Costco. The car battery was very old so I bought a battery from Costco but the car still won’t start with the new battery. After the car was towed to West Tire and Auto Repair, the technician (I didn’t catch his name) carefully checked the car and found the problem with the starter. He is a very nice guy and is very knowledgeable and experienced. I am very glad he fixed my car. Now the car runs well with a new starter. The service advisor Ryan is also very helpful and very nice. I’ll definitely go back to West Tire and Auto Repair next time if my car needs repair or service. Thank you!

reviews.author: Byron Gutwein
reviews.text: Needed a nail removed and plugged to relair my run flat tire. Some shops would not try the repair for fear of failure. They got the job done quickly and a very resonable cost. Only 9000 miles on the tire and worth the risk on my part. Thanks West Tire. Byron Gutwein 1/7/26

reviews.author: Tom Bongiorno
reviews.text: EXCELLENT Service. Couldn't recommend them more. They fixed an issue created by Ford Service. I had them install new Eibachs all around.Pricing was reasonable I have no problem this business will succeed.

reviews.author: Karen Hawa
reviews.text: I would give 10 stars if I could. Our family has gone to West Tire and Auto for years, but most recently Derrick and the guys have gone above and beyond to help my daughter save her beloved first car. I can't even put into words how out of his way Derrick went to help us through a stressful time. The most trustworthy, helpful, and fair mechanics around. 10 stars.

reviews.author: Patsy Pruitt
reviews.text: Thank goodness for this shop. We were on vacation in myrtle beach when we discovered our brake lights wouldn't go off. The maintenance guy at the hotel recommended West Tire and Auto Repair. They got me in first thing the next morning. It took about 45 minutes and we were good to go. Thank you so much for your help. I highly recommend this shop if you are in the area.

reviews.author: Kim Robertson
reviews.text: Prompt, Professional! Derrick and Gage communicated clearly..put my mind at ease that I had chosen wisely! Local, family owned!!!

reviews.author: Bob Montgomery
reviews.text: I come from a family of service station owners and worked in them from 15 to age 23. I have worked on just about everything and still do at age 73. No one has ever touched my cars but me until today. Unfortunately, I hurt my back in a fall and fortunately, on vacation, I met West Side. It reminded me of the family business in Knoxville, TN - CHAPMAN ENTERPRISES. As I waited to have a technician confirm my suspicions either brake pads or wheel bearing, I got to listen to Ryan and Derrick, front desk, deal with all customers, vendors, parts providers, etc. . and was so impressed with their knowledge and people skills, I decided to follow their recommendation right down the list. All my family visits Myrtle Beach most years since 1960 and continue. We are aging and need someone we can trust. I just sent them a similar note with my Recommendation to stop by if they need help. They will not regret it. Quality work, quality people, and reasonable prices. It's hard to beat.

reviews.author: melissa welch
reviews.text: Awesome group of people here I really appreciate their honesty ,From fthe front door with a smile and Derek's very helpful !! Thank you West Automotive

reviews.author: Elijah McKitrick
reviews.text: I would give negative stars if possible. Quoted me $80.00 for an alignment then jacked the price up AFTER the alignment was done to $130.00. After looking at the alignment sheet the only thing touched on the vehicle was the rear camber and they did not even try to meet the specs I asked for. Nobody ever communicated with me at all through this process. I WILL NOT BE BACK.

reviews.author: gator rittenberry
reviews.text: Having a custom vehicle makes it hard to find a repair shop to feel comfortable about using. but the staff at West Tire and Automotive make it very easy to leave my thunderbird with them. Absolutely great service each time

reviews.author: Jeff Beaudoin
reviews.text: Their service is always professional and definitely they do excellent work. All employees an Staff treats you as family. Id highly recommend using them . The jobs performed is what you pay for unlike paying for services that isn't wrong with your vehicle. It's definitely my go to auto care. I'm actually handy with auto maintenance however if it's out of my knowledge , West Tire and Auto is the perfect mechanical solution. I take Both mine and wife's vehicle there. 5 star from ME.

reviews.author: Mark A
reviews.text: Had an emergency while traveling through Myrtle, was referred to West Tire by another shop due to availability. They stepped up and helped me and my family get fixed up quickly, affordable and quickly. Can't give a higher than 5 star or I would.

reviews.author: jacob sanders
reviews.text: Went in for an alignment due to front end being loose while towing. Found that I needed almost my whole front end redone.Had me fixed up in 24 hours. Great people fair price, will definitely be back if something happens while I’m on vacation. These guys are awesome. I highly recommend that you go see them.

reviews.author: DONALD MOLITOR
reviews.text: I took my 71 Monte Carlo to West Tire and Auto Repair today for front end alignment and a great job they did ! I will be back in the future for any repair needs, the whole crew was very professional, courteous and knowledgeable ! Thank you, Donnie Molitor Praise The Lord !!!

reviews.author: Golf Bugs
reviews.text: Use West Tire and Auto with confidence. I’ve used them numerous times and they continue to excel. You can rely on honest, knowledgeable and consistent results. The day my car in for service. They were very busy, and it was extremely hot. Besides the booked appointments, they went the extra mile to help callers that needed service and the walk in customers. They were diagnosing/coaching customers questions on the phone. This is a local business that deserves support. Get over or call West Tire & Auto for all you automotive needs. You will see how great the team is. Thanks!

reviews.author: Guilherme HelenCecilia
reviews.text: I had a horrible experience taking my van to work there. I took it to get some things fixed and to check why the engine light was on. So far so good. They told me what it was and I paid to fix it. It was $773. So far so good. The cost isn't the problem. The next day the liz came on again and the air conditioning wasn't working, but it was before. Then they told me that the liz was on for several reasons. So I asked to get it fixed. I asked for the cost. They told me it would be $533. So I asked to get it fixed and get another tire. So I went to get it again and paid $533. They told me that on Monday, in this case, August 9, 2025, I would have to leave the van in the morning to finish it, and it would cost another $840. They also told me that my tire was no good. When they were working on the van, they broke all the fittings on the van's dashboard. So I took the van to another shop, with all the receipts for what they had changed, and they They told me that nothing that was there had been changed! And the tire that they told me was no good is on the van and working perfectly!

reviews.author: Tony B
reviews.text: After doing business here, I wouldn't think of going anywhere else for tires. Great recommendation from the guys up front. Good price, Timely service. Very professional. Definitely recommend West Tire.

reviews.author: Liz Paris
reviews.text: Ryan was really on top with his expertise he was specific and pointed out a detail that had never occurred to me. He told me my tires had been driven on flat and they wore on the inside something I would never had known it took a little longer than I had expected but the end result was a positive I had the opportunity to observe their operation they were busy but polite fair and honest with each customer they repaired things that most other auto services would have jacked the customer on. Impressive. I appreciate the kind of service and will definitely refer others to that shop. Thank you Liz Paris

reviews.author: Taylor Pinkstaff Archer
reviews.text: We ran into car trouble while in the Myrtle Beach area on vacation, it’s 100 degrees out and the AC in our traverse went out and we have a 2 yr old. We called several Chevy dealers and mechanics and no one had availability to look at it for at least a week. We called West on recommendation of one of the Chevy dealers and they worked us in first thing the next day, keeping in close contact with what they found wrong and price estimates for repair. We left with our vehicle and working air conditioning by closing time the same day and our bill was reasonable for the services provided. We are so grateful for their kindness and assistance in our time of need.

reviews.author: shannon jessup
reviews.text: I took my car in because I thought it needed an alignment. They called me about an hour later saying I actually didn't need an alignment and that thry really didn't see anything wrong. I was shocked as usually auto places don't ever say nothing is wrong or will just do the service even if not needed to make money. Not only did they not charge me, the nice guy at the front desk replaced my key fabb battery and gave me a really cool pen and didn't charge me for that either. I highly recommend for anyone who has been ripped off in the past. These are some of the good guys. This is my 3rd time using them and so far have never over charged or found "other issues" with my car. This time I got 4 tires and an alignment. When they called to say it was ready, I said, did you find anything else wrong?They said, no, when I went to go pay.I said, are you sure they looked at everything When they had the wheels off and it was up on the lift, they said, yep.And I said well thats crazy and awesome that for once in found an honest mechanic, no offense. Even getting an oil change at any place else.They're going to find other things that you need and three times now they have yet to find any additional issues than what I brought the car in for and that is very rare. I will probably be using them for everything that I can from now on.They have definitely proven, they are honest.And they also have really awesome pens. Lol

reviews.author: Rhoda Boney
reviews.text: 2nd visit. Excellent service, friendly, knowledgeable, didn't do unnecessary work. Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: barret frank
reviews.text: I had my car towed to them, luckily they got me looked at and fixed in the same day. I feel the price was fair.

reviews.author: Tommy Holt
reviews.text: Dropped my truck off without an appointment. Guys were very receptive and helpful. Communicated with me on the problem and the solution. Very fairly priced and great customer service. I would recommend to anyone. 5 Stars from me

reviews.author: Michael Conyers
reviews.text: My husband and I were visiting from Charlotte, North Carolina and had to have some minor repair work done on his truck. They gave us an appointment and told us they look forward to serving us. There was another issue that arose upon traveling to Myrtle Beach, so my husband called and spoke to one of the mechanics there and they told him they would be able to get that looked at as well for him. We were greeted with warm conversations and smiles. Everyone was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. This is a wonderful location and I will absolutely refer anyone who is seeking Auto work in the area.

reviews.author: mike bennett
reviews.text: The worst.... Stay away.... I'm a car dealer and they thought they could do the slimy up sell for stuff not needed

reviews.author: Steven Foster
reviews.text: Great shop , honest . had a horrible experienece at another shop, these guys are honest and fast !!!

reviews.author: Victor Murphy
reviews.text: I had brakes and rotors replaced on my 2022 Murano. The service took less than an hour at a competitive price. The staff was courteous and professional. I would highly recommend!! A+++

reviews.author: James Nester
reviews.text: When to this shop from out of town with an issue with air conditioning. Had issue repaired and out in less than two hours. These guys are great. A+ from me, hands down. If you live in Myrtle Beach, please check out this shop.

reviews.author: Pat Hafey
reviews.text: West Tire and Auto Repair is awesome! They quickly fixed nail puncture in my Jeep tire a couple years ago at a very reasonable charge. Today I thought a bolt had gone through the tire and they took a look and pulled it out with no puncture. No charge. Highly recommend this company! They are honest! I will be returning for sure when I need it!

reviews.author: Veronica Good
reviews.text: West Tire is the best mechanic shop I have ever used and the only one I go to. I always recommend them to anyone for everything from oil changes to big fixes. They are kind, willing to explain car troubles, and non-condescending (which is so rare). They are reasonably priced and honest about their expenses and work. They have seen my car through new tires, engine repair, and major emergencies. They are true friends to my car and excellent, unmatched mechanics.

reviews.author: richie gerardi
reviews.text: As the owner of a mobile car mechanic business, I must say the shop is definitely a five star! they do it all! Very clean, very reasonably priced very experience! I will definitely recommend Mechanic shop to my customers when there is specific work that needs to be done at a shop! What a great group of guys!

reviews.author: Matt Vaughn
reviews.text: Was in town for a local car show and needed a front end alignment from where we had been working on the truck at home and Ran out of time…the truck had a lift and oversized wheels and tires on it but Derrick was able to work it in that morning and had it back before lunch….good people and good work! Will definitely keep them in mind when in the area!

reviews.author: Irsell
reviews.text: Always direct and straightforward. No funky business. Owner is super nice and knows what he's doing.

reviews.author: Jenna Pakosta
reviews.text: I’ve used West tire several times over the last few years. I don’t know anything about cars but they give me the feeling of honest, fair, and efficient with every service that I receive.

reviews.author: Angel Spicer
reviews.text: I called and they were able to get my tire within an hour, I arrived and left within 30-40 minutes to have it changed. While waiting, they even gave my children a snack. Plus the price couldn’t be beat!

reviews.author: George
reviews.text: They called within an hour of dropping the car off for service. They told me the problem and explained the fix and the cost. I asked if they could do it quickly since we were traveling for Thanksgiving I picked up the car the next day and it was fixed and the bill was almost the same as the estimate. Our experience was as good as it could have been. Thank you , Mike Winget

reviews.author: Trav Rasnake
reviews.text: No need for me to shop around on vacation. I needed an alignment in my Tundra and made the appt. Got me in the next day, took less than an hour. Truck drives great! They have a customer for life. Met the owner, awesome dude. You can’t go wrong! Came highly recommended from folks at our condo community.

reviews.author: Brian W
reviews.text: I love West Tire and Auto!!! It's the only place in Myrtle Beach that I take my car. It's coming up on two years with them, and my car runs like a top. They do thorough work that I trust. I have had to take several long distance road trips, and getting it serviced before and after - my car has never had a problem. I was referred there by a friend and I would definitely recommend West Tire and Auto Repair - which is why I am writing this review! Great pricing (quoted exactly what I expected), awesome service, and peace of mind that the work is done right. 5-stars

reviews.author: jill Lowery
reviews.text: I couldn't ask for better service. My 2020 Dodge Charger blew a tire around lunch time. I had it towed to West Tire. They didn't have the tires I wanted in stock. But they got right on.It. They got the tires delivered and installed. I was able to pick it up before they closed today. I would definitely recommend them to everyone!!!

reviews.author: Amy Sommers
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of visiting West Tire and Auto Repair, and I couldn't be more satisfied with the service I received. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with a friendly smile and a professional attitude that immediately put me at ease. Timeliness is one of the most crucial factors for me when it comes to auto repair, and West Tire and Auto Repair exceeded my expectations. They quickly pulled it in to check the brakes and rotate the tires. I was told by the local Toyota dealership I needed new brakes which was t anywhere near the truth per the West tire mechanic. Their honesty is the quality that stood out the most as well as not trying to upsell me on services I didn't need. Their transparency and straightforward approach made me feel confident that I was in trustworthy hands. The competency of the staff at West Tire and Auto Repair is truly outstanding.The technicians are clearly skilled and knowledgeable, which is evident in the excellent service they provide. Overall, I highly recommend West Tire and Auto Repair to anyone in need of reliable, honest, and timely auto service. They have earned a loyal customer in me, and I will definitely be returning for all my future auto repair needs. Thank you, West Tire and Auto Repair, for your exceptional service!

reviews.author: Christiaan Polovitch
reviews.text: Great shop with great people!! Recently took my 2002 Trans Am to them for service, for an upcoming 3k mile road trip. Their quote and time estimate were pretty much dead on. Derrick and Noah were very nice and professional. Would definitely bring my car and truck here again.

reviews.author: Samantha Edwards
reviews.text: West Auto was fast and efficient with my car repairs. Their knowledgeable techs diagnosed the issue and provided an affordable repair. My car is driving better than the day I purchased it 2 years ago. So happy I chose West Auto!!!

reviews.author: Phillip McCaughey
reviews.text: What a great small business West Tire is.Glad I found them and will be using them for all my automotive repairs in the future. 4 tires mounted , balanced and alignment for a price better than any major competitors and completed the same day in a timely manner. From the moment I walked in the were polite, professional and knowledgeable, they know how to treat a customer. Thank you to all the staff.

reviews.author: Meg
reviews.text: I had a great experience with West Tire & Auto. I brought my Jaguar in for a crankshaft seal leak, and they had it fixed and running perfectly within a day! I also REALLY APPRECIATE that they didn’t do that thing, you know when shops see a young woman and try to tell her she “needs more blinker fluid” or charges $800 for an oil change? They don’t do that here. These are some genuine, honest, hardworking people. They are very transparent and fair and communicate very clearly. They make you feel like a friend, not just another paying customer. I wish I could give more than 5 stars.

reviews.author: Carol Turner
reviews.text: Staff is friendly and courteous. Technician got me in and out and the price was reasonable! I'll go back for service.

reviews.author: Paul Leiva
reviews.text: Great service Ryan kept me abreast of what was being done and he was very nice and knowledgeable. Thank you Ryan!

reviews.author: Chanda Heard
reviews.text: If I could give them more than five stars, I would. I had a serious brake problem that turned out to be the master cylinder. I had gone to another brake shop and they were terrible. I was in Myrtle Beach on vacation, so I didn't know where to go, but luckily I found these guys. They fixed the issue in my vehicle in less than an hour and charged way less than what I had expected. They were very professional and courteous. I don't like having to have vehicle repairs, especially on vacation, but if I have to, I would want to work with these guys again. Some of the best mechanics I've ever dealt with!

reviews.author: Daniela Prentice
reviews.text: My experience was amazing, we were visiting the area from New York, and unfortunately got a flat tire. But these guys made the experience quick, easy and affordable! Everyone was very kind from the front desk to the mechanics. And at the end my son even got a popsicle, it’s really the small gestures that keep customers coming back. Thank you all <3

reviews.author: Robert Blevins
reviews.text: I had a mechanic when we bought our house around the corner from West. But after a few years he sold his business and retired. But I had a riding mower and a bike both of which had tore issues which they took care of reasonably and nicely. Considering they are such small things I was surprised they were just as nice as if I was getting a big job done. So our mechanic retired and we we needed new break pads and rotors for our Wrangler. They gave us a price estimate and we agreed. Come time to pick it back up we got our bill...it was slightly LOWER than quoted. Imagine my surprise lol. I can't remember the last time my final price came in lower than my quote for anything. So we knew we also had a radiator leak. But it was small and we don't drive very far. So we have kind of ignored it. Just made sure we always had water in it. When they saw it I explained and they told me it could let completely go all at once which would be an issue. So we had them give me a quote for a new radiator. It was reasonable and needed to be done so we scheduled a date. When we go to pick it up we get the bill...and AGAIN it was slightly LOWER than the estimate. Their customer service for anything small or large has been refreshing to see. There are still places that value every customer.

reviews.author: Christin Sandidge
reviews.text: We took our daughter’s car to West Tire and Auto for numerous repairs. They were friendly and professional and completed all repairs that day. We are pleased so far with the repairs. Communication was excellent. We received a call shortly after dropping the car off with a price for all repairs. This was our first time using West Tire however it won’t be our last.

reviews.author: Kristy Foreman
reviews.text: Absolutely excellent experience. The staff was very knowledgeable and courteous. I will definitely be sharing my experience with anyone that has any tire needs. Thank you so much and I will be back

reviews.author: Jack Roemer
reviews.text: All of the staff at West Tire and Auto are very friendly and professional. The mechanics are like surgeons and always diagnose my vehicle issues with ease. The most important things are they are honest and fair. I have given the West family my business for over 25 years now and I will continue to for many years. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Cheryl Beard
reviews.text: Everyone was very helpful and pleasant. They told me approximately 1 hour and they had my tire fixed in that time. We are from out of town and it's nice to know there is a dependable company to work with. Will definitely use them again if needed.

reviews.author: Phil Barbieri
reviews.text: Had a screw in my tire. They got right in and out. Super friendly. Highly recommend. Thanks for great service.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: This place was recommended by a friend of the owner. No other Shop would touch my car with what I wanted done. West tire and auto had confidence to do what I asked the right way. The staff there are very polite and extremely knowledgeable. I would highly recommend this place for any automotive needs!

reviews.author: Jim Lewandoski
reviews.text: Excellent service. Prompt, reliable, expert work. Do not hesitate to bring your vehicle to West, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Randy Merritt
reviews.text: Great place to do business. These guys are real mechanics and will not stop until they diagnose the problem. Everyone that you interact with makes you feel like family. I highly recommend this shop!! Steven has excellent communication skills. Keep up the good work. Thanks to everyone at West Tire! Randy

reviews.author: Ted Arlier
reviews.text: I am from CT drove here for vacation. I had to get my tires balanced and get a minor repair done with the front end of my SUV. I am really impressed with honesty and knowledge of these guys. They are very professional. (Derrick is a gentleman). I highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Inn Rentals
reviews.text: I couldn't be happier with my service from West Tire Auto Repair. They were wonderful to work with. They know what they're doing and treat their customers with respect. I would highly recommend them to anyone and everyone. Thanks again for getting my brake lines fixed.

reviews.author: Rick Gabrielson
reviews.text: I’m always leery of taking a vehicle to a shop as I usually do my own work. These guys were highly recommended so I gave them a shot. They called a few times during the repair process to keep me updated. The work was done correctly and very reasonably priced. They are my now my “go to” shop for work I can’t do myself.

reviews.author: Robert Safford
reviews.text: Came in for an oil change and got outstanding service on my 2008 F150. Mike gave my truck a thorough check. Found a nail in my left rear tire that got patched. The staff really are committed to getting your vehicle repaired at a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Joey Fickling
reviews.text: I recently had a major front suspension rebuild done on my old solid axle 4x4 Suburban. My mechanic recommended West Tire and Auto Repair for the finishing touch alignment. These folks were prompt, professional, and did a great job on my old truck. I would definitely recommend someone to them for service in the future.

reviews.author: Juanita Nieves Webb
reviews.text: Great staff! Answered all my questions and explained what was going on with my vehicle. Costs were explained up front and their prices are extremely reasonable! I would highly recommend West Tire and Auto Repair! I will not be going anywhere else, from now on (this was my 2nd visit) for my vehicle care. You guys rock!!!

reviews.author: Michelle Roth
reviews.text: I was referred to West Tire by multiple people after being told an outrageous price for a service at another place. Their quote was 150 lower BUT they inspected it and it turned out that the problem was not even what the other place initially stated! Saved me 400$ and I appreciated the honesty and thoroughness! Will recommend!

reviews.author: Carol Ann Fullex
reviews.text: It was my 1st time here. I needed a wheel alignment and tire rotation. I wish I would have found them sooner. They were so friendly and professional. I plan on going here for future work. Great service, price and work. Thank you.

reviews.author: Joseph Morgan
reviews.text: Great service, great people. I brought my truck in while on vacation having misfire issues. They replaced coils,plugs and the valve cover gasket and had me running great again the same day at an affordable price. Would recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Mica Hendricks
reviews.text: I HIGHLY recommend West Tire and Auto to everyone I know! They are honest, affordable, do great work, and treat you like they have known you their whole life. The only reason I gave them five stars is because I couldn’t give them six!

reviews.author: Joseph Embrey
reviews.text: I called around and they recommended this place to me and man, this was probably the quickest and nicest place i’ve been to since i’ve moved down to SC. Staff was friendly and definitely treat you like family. 10/10 will be coming back for future car work.

reviews.author: Ray Robertson
reviews.text: West Tire did a great job on my truck . The pricing was fair and the work done was great as well. Thanks again guys.

reviews.author: L.Vaughan
reviews.text: I needed a tire plugged but unfortunately it was beyond repair. The service I received was excellent. They were very nice, honest, and professional. If they had my tire in stock I definitely would have used them. I do plan to go back in the future and reccomend to others.

reviews.author: Paul Nardin
reviews.text: West Tire completed an inspection of my car so I could take it to the track. They were, thorough, efficient and reasonable. Thanks.

reviews.author: Harry smith
reviews.text: We almost made to the beach got a nail in our tire, well we though ended up being a small bolt. Very nice people. had is in and out ready to go in less the 30 minutes thanks

reviews.author: Assia Lowery
reviews.text: From the moment I walk through the door, the team is incredibly welcoming, eager to help, and always ready to find answers. Everyone is professional and kind. This is my new go-to place for anything my car needs!

reviews.author: Gabrielle Wright
reviews.text: This is the best shop I've ever been to. Everyone was so kind and they got my service done quickly. Will definitely be coming back when my car needs work again.

reviews.author: michael carr
reviews.text: Awesome experience as always. Wouldn’t go anywhere else in Myrtle beach. Steven was very knowledgeable and helpful. His depth of knowledge related to automobiles is remarkable! I would go as far as to say that me may be a genius! If you go anywhere else in Myrtle Beach for automotive care you are crazy!

reviews.author: Lew Bic
reviews.text: Great place! Service was impeccable. Call and got a real person instead of like other places. Got my vehicle fixed quickly. Very friendly and remember me from my phone call if I could give them more stars I would.

reviews.author: Robert Blair
reviews.text: Very nice guys and were always willing to help us out whenever I needed it. They were willing to work with me making payments on my truck and were flexible with my payment schedule. Would definitely recommend anyone to go these guys.

reviews.author: Damorron Joseph
reviews.text: Great customer service and reasonable pricing. Definitely would recommend to anyone who appreciate upfront, honest and dependable service. Thank you West Tire and Auto!

reviews.author: Maureen Ciarlo
reviews.text: I am over the moon and so happy with the service here at West tire auto. Ryan was a huge help with all my questions. Thank you so much

reviews.author: big johns Recommendation
reviews.text: The staff there are awesome and do amazing work, they really make you feel like family there. I recommend everyone that needs work done on the vehicle check them out. Thanks West Tire!!!!

reviews.author: Betty Shelley
reviews.text: Wow! How nice! Thanks for taking your time to talk to me about my concerns. My car drives noticeably better! I will be back!

reviews.author: Meredith Dark
reviews.text: West Tire & Auto is wonderful! I’ve been having my car(s) serviced by employees of WT&A since 2010 and it’s always done right and done well. WT&A is The Place to go! Can’t recommend them enough! Thank you!

reviews.author: Jen Lundy
reviews.text: I went in thinking I needed to have my serpentine belt replaced. Turns out I just had the wrong battery in my car. They swapped it out for the correct one and it only cost me $51. Being female, I feel like I can really trust these guys. Always a good experience when I go there.

reviews.author: Victoria Levy
reviews.text: Outstanding, personalized customer service. They’ll give you several price points of choices, when purchasing tires. They stand behind their work product. And they make a mean cup of coffee for you to enjoy in the waiting room.

reviews.author: Gary Hersh
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the service that I received. The price was fair. Kelly was friendly and helpful. I have had work done here before and that is why I came back. I would recommend them.

reviews.author: David Turbeville
reviews.text: I was able to stop in one afternoon for an oil change and tire rotation. They great to deal with, got me right and and out. Great honest folks at West Tire and Auto repair. I recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Cynthia Vickers
reviews.text: Best shop in Myrtle Beach for tires & repairs. Best prices, extremely professional, very knowledgeable & repairs are top Notch!!

reviews.author: Thomas Post
reviews.text: Stopped in for a shake in front end. Crestin went over my car and took video of problem to show me. Fixed in a timely manner and test drove car with me after. Highly recommend west tire!!!
